trust_boundary: Records describe evaluator obligations, not accepted candidate declarations. Only source-bundle integrity and report syntax are implemented.

checks: Fourteen spatial strata in source order and thickness
Actual element-to-property binding, MC law, gamma,c,phi,K0,nu,listed Es
Actual initial stresses and plastic-state evolution
open_choices: rock Es, subject to source stiffness requirement
unspecified dilation/tension/interface options, subject to engineering review
negative_controls: unused correct material declarations with wrong element bindings

checks: Actual shell/wall thickness 1.00 and 0.62 m
Used linear-elastic structural E=30 GPa, nu=0.20, unit weight=25 kN/m3
Assembled structural body loads and reactions after activation
Irregular plan, approximate dimensions and diagonal member connectivity
Four outer brace levels, one inner level, distinct ring-beam event
Absolute elevations versus depth datum; distinguish wall top and toe
Declared inner base -15.10 m and inner wall toe -21.60 m give fixed 6.50 m embedment across all cases

wall-top datum mistaken for depth datum

checks: Five positions 0..4 m below inner top; beta .30 label with original depths, equivalent thickness .62 m
Fixed dimensioned inner embedment 6.50 m; n .40 is a rounded legacy label, not an exact-ratio constraint
Independent histories through final inner excavation
All other physical choices and monitoring interpretation unchanged
negative_controls: sequential relocation of a loaded brace
different material or observations between cases
inner toe altered by inventing an exact n denominator

checks: Replay all nine logical stages including their installation events
Substeps preserve all source water/excavation milestones and the declared Stage 7/8/9 ordering correction

Excavation removes loads and stiffness; prior stress/force state survives
Stress-free installation does not suppress prior movement
Source initial-water rule and staged water levels in consistent datum
Actual pore pressures, effective stresses and hydraulic boundary treatment
open_choices: intermediate substep levels consistent with milestones
negative_controls: invented 20 m formula required by grader
total/effective stress unit or sign mismatch

checks: Full 3D model and local refinement
Side-normal restraints, fully fixed bottom, free excavated faces
Sufficient domain and numerical resolution

checks: Review all ten DBC stations and all ten CX outer-wall profiles before viewing results
Interpolate independent native results on source monitoring locations/profiles
End-of-Stage-1 baseline, positive downward DBC settlement, top-to-toe CX horizontal norm, mm units
Retain complete native fields for consistency inspection

checks: Evaluator-owned native loader, process allowlist and stage runner

Original report, native project, table, images and memo
